jobDescription:

- researching, refining, and evangelizing best practices that make solutions more scalable, efficient, and future-ready. Blending visionary thinking with hands-on expertise, you’ll set new benchmarks for design excellence, governance, and innovation across all implementations. Define governance models for app grouping, versioning, and deployments. Ensure alignment between business needs, solution design, and platform capabilities. Serve as the central authority for design reviews, ensuring scalability, security, and performance. Guide teams in solving complex design challenges and improving overall delivery quality. Best Practices & Knowledge Enablement Build a repository of reusable assets, patterns, and reference architectures. Conduct internal design workshops and reviews to strengthen architecture competency. Continuously benchmark projects to identify and share best practices. Innovation & Research Leadership Explore emerging technologies and design methods to drive solution efficiency. Pilot new frameworks and validate architecture models to enhance Kissflow’s maturity. Collaborate with Product and Engineering to share field insights and influence roadmaps. Customer Advisory & Executive Engagement Partner with CXOs and IT leaders to shape solution strategy and governance. Represent PS in technical reviews and architecture councils. Act as a trusted advisor guiding customers toward sustainable, future-ready architectures. - Pega systems, Appian, Outsystems, Mendix, Power Apps, Servicenow. Minimum 3-4 years of experience working with LCNC platforms is a must. - comfortable engaging with CXO-level stakeholders. Deep understanding of technology landscapes and business challenges specifically within Retail, FMCG, or Manufacturing sectors. title: Client Director
jobDescription: The Kissflow Client Director will serve as a strategic advisor and trusted partner to client stakeholders at large enterprise clients, with a focus on driving high-impact digital transformation programs leveraging the Kissflow platform. This individual will balance client consulting, executive relationship management, and delivery oversight—ensuring clients realize maximum value from their investment in Kissflow’s low-code/no-code (LCNC) solutions. Key Responsibilities Advise business and technology leaders on digital transformation strategies and adoption of LCNC platforms, leading to tangible business outcomes. Facilitate ideation workshops with diverse business units to identify and unlock value from enterprise-wide transformation programs. Bridge the gap between Kissflow's delivery teams and customer stakeholders, ensuring alignment on business goals, solution design, implementation, and adoption. Oversee end-to-end delivery of multi-year transformation engagements, managing priorities, timelines, risk, and change management across complex enterprise environments. Build strong, trusted relationships with client CXOs, acting as a thought leader and advocate throughout the client’s digital journey. Identify and pursue account growth opportunities, including new use cases and expanded adoption of Kissflow’s offerings. Conduct regular business reviews, prepare executive-level presentations, and represent Kissflow at client leadership forums. Required Experience & Skills 6+ years of experience in enterprise client management, consulting, or digital transformation leadership preferably for US region Consulting background with a Big 4 or tier-1 advisory firm strongly preferred. Demonstrated ability to engage and influence C-level stakeholders; outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Experience facilitating workshops, delivering executive presentations, and managing change in complex organizations. Strong understanding of business process reengineering, requirements gathering, solution mapping, and business-IT alignment. Prior experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Kissflow, Power Apps, Mendix, Out Systems) is advantageous. Track record managing large enterprise accounts in sectors such as FMCG, Retail, or Manufacturing is preferred. Hands-on technology/technical project management experience is a plus. MBA or advanced degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field preferred.

title: Manager - Digital Marketing
jobDescription: We are looking for a Senior Digital Manager to own and drive Kissflow's integrated digital growth strategy across organic, paid, AI search, account-based marketing (ABM), conversion rate optimization (CRO) and omnichannel presence. This is not a channel management role. The strategy is already in place, and we are looking for a hands-on leader who can execute, optimize, scale programs, develop a high-performing team, and deliver measurable pipeline impact. Key Responsibilities What We're Looking For 8–10 years of experience in B2B digital marketing. Strong experience across both organic and paid growth channels. Proven ownership of marketing budgets with accountability for pipeline or revenue outcomes. Prior experience managing and developing teams. Background in Enterprise B2B or Saa S environments. Understanding of long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and account-based marketing. Familiarity with AI-era search trends, including AI Overviews, LLM citations, zero-click search, and omnichannel discoverability. Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Linked In Campaign Manager, SEO tools (Ahrefs, SEMrush), CRM attribution systems, and ABM platforms. Organic Growth & Discoverability Drive Kissflow's presence across Google, Bing, Chat GPT, Perplexity, Gemini, You Tube, Reddit, review platforms, and industry communities Lead the four pillars of organic growth: Category Authority, Vertical Market Expansion, Content Engine, and Authority Building Oversee AI-powered growth initiatives including SEO automation, content optimization, and authority-building programs Own full-funnel content performance, from awareness through MQL generation Improve conversion rates across landing pages and critical customer journeys Track and report on AI citation frequency, AI share of voice, organic MQLs, and content-influenced pipeline Paid Growth & Account-Based Marketing Manage full-funnel paid marketing programs across Google Ads, Linked In, ABM, retargeting, and contact-level advertising platforms Execute brand awareness campaigns across key industries and target markets Drive pipeline generation through ABM and demand-generation initiatives Own budget allocation, experimentation, performance measurement, and scaling successful campaigns Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management Lead and mentor a team of 3–4 specialists across content, organic growth, paid marketing, and analytics Establish performance goals and support team development Present growth strategy, performance metrics, and pipeline impact to senior leadership on a monthly basis If you are passionate about building scalable growth engines, leading teams, and driving business impact through modern digital marketing, we'd love to hear from you.
